author: MysticNTN
what_it_is: Saves the agg23 SNES core (Analogue Pocket, Sept 2022, v0.1.x) wrote while reproducing issue #2 (saves lost after 'Load SMC'): Reboot1/Reboot2 are the 8 KB Chrono Trigger save copied off the Pocket after each reboot (identical); End is the 64 KB file found after switching ROMs, which the core author describes as garbage (default memory state), attributed to a Pocket firmware bug.
note: Renamed by the uploader (' - Reboot1' etc. appended to the core's '<rom name>.sav'). End.sav is a corrupt save, kept because it is what the device wrote.
